razor_priya: Pattern: I defaulted to sink_ba_ba1. Reality: It consistently rests on bathroom_shelf_ba1. Next time: Always check bathroom_shelf_ba1 first.

mug_priya: Pattern: I assumed it stayed in the kitchen (cupboard or coffee table) during the evening. Reality: At 21:39 on day 7, it was at desk_b1. It moves to the bedroom desk in the evening, not just the living room. Next time: Check desk_b1 for evening queries; do not default to kitchen_table_k1 or coffee_table_l1 after 20:00.

water_bottle_priya: Pattern: I assumed it stayed at kitchen_table_k1 based on previous evening data. Reality: At 21:38 on day 7, it was at desk_b1. Like the mug, it moves to the bedroom desk in the evening. Next time: Check desk_b1 for evening queries; do not default to kitchen_table_k1 after 20:00.

glass_priya: Pattern: I defaulted to kitchen_table_k1 for late-night queries based on day 6 data. Reality: At 22:41 on day 7, it was at nightstand_b1. It does not have a fixed late-night location; it can remain in the kitchen or move to the bedroom. Next time: Do not default to kitchen_table_k1 for late queries. Check nightstand_b1 and kitchen_table_k1 with equal weight; look for specific evidence of movement.

General Note: Avoid rigid "late-night" location rules for glass_priya, water_bottle_priya, and mug_priya. Previous notes suggesting they stay in the kitchen or living room are not reliable defaults for evening queries (after 20:00). These items frequently move to desk_b1 or nightstand_b1 in the evening. Prioritize bedroom locations (desk_b1, nightstand_b1) for evening queries unless there is specific evidence they remain in the kitchen.
